title: A2A-T corpus input case format
description: First-hand definition of the data-driven workflow case consumed by the corpus engine. One file is a JSON array of case records. Each case declares an ordered array of SDK API steps (input) and one expectation per step (expected, aligned by index). Keys are strict: unknown keys are load-time errors.

id.description: Case primary key, unique within one scenario.

caseDimension.description: Accuracy dimension this case exercises, the aggregation key for accuracy statistics.

caseDesc.description: One business-facing sentence describing the case.

caseCategory.description: Open enumeration of case categories, e.g. 正常 / 异常 / 边界 / 模糊语义 / ... ; statistics aggregate by the raw value.

input.description: Ordered SDK API steps; array order is the execution order; the same API may appear multiple times.

api.description: Registered SDK facade method name, e.g. generateTaskPromptFromText.

args.description: Request arguments for the step. Literal values take precedence; a {"$fromStep": N, "$field": "a.b"} object copies the field from the response of step N (1-based, earlier steps only).

expected.description: Per-step expectations, aligned by index with input.

data.description: Subset assertion against the step response payload: every listed key must equal. Applies to the payload root, or to its nested data map when the payload carries one (FilledParamData).

dataExact.description: When true, the asserted map must contain exactly the listed keys (no extras).

errCode.description: Exact SDK error catalog code expected when result is error; may be empty when the code is not asserted.

errMessage.description: Exact error message; when absent only non-empty is required.

errMessageContains.description: Substring the error message must contain.
